title: Madrid T-Minus 2 Days — Billboard Documents Riyadh Air Metropolitano Preparations; Adidas Flamboyan Sale Begins May 30
detail: With the DtMF World Tour's 10-night Madrid residency opening in two days (May 30), Bad Bunny used the off-day following the Lisbon finale to travel toward Spain's capital. Billboard Pro published an in-depth piece on how Riyadh Air Metropolitano — the 70,000-capacity home of Atlético de Madrid — is coordinating with city authorities, transit operators, and hotel groups to absorb what will be the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history: 10 consecutive dates spanning May 30–June 15 with a projected 550,000+ attendees. The city's tourism board noted the residency is expected to generate more than €300 million in direct and indirect economic impact — coinciding with Pope Leo XIV's visit to Madrid in the same fortnight, which Focus on Travel News described as 'Madrid's busiest fortnight ever.' In the same 48-hour window, AceShowbiz reported that Bad Bunny ranked #8 on YouTube Music's Top Artists chart globally for May 28, 2026 — reflecting sustained post-Lisbon streaming momentum. The Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) enters its final countdown before its wide global release via Adidas Confirmed on May 30 — the same day as opening night in Madrid. The shoe, named after Puerto Rico's iconic flamboyán tree, had its exclusive boutique debut at All The Right NYC on May 15; RSVP registration through Adidas Confirmed was active ahead of the May 30 wide drop.
